name: us1-style-prose-audit
description: T098 — FR-003 requires the run summary to state how each project's style was resolved so a wrong binding can be audited after the fact. Prose is the DEFAULT output (no --json), so the per-project audit at effects.discovery.projects.<KEY>.{style,style_source} must be rendered there too, nested under the discovery effect and ordered by project key. Both ports must emit byte-identical prose (NFR-1/FR-020).
